interface.external_selector_mapping: {a,b}=00,01,10,11 select mux_in[0], mux_in[1], mux_in[2], mux_in[3] respectively; a and b are not module ports

semantics.timing: Pure combinational response to current c,d; no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement
semantics.implementation: Only wiring, constants, and three 2-to-1 muxes: mux_in[0]=c?1:d; mux_in[1]=0; mux_in[2]=d?c:1; mux_in[3]=c?d:0. External 4-to-1 mux is outside TopModule.
semantics.minimality: Three distinct nonconstant outputs each require a mux because none is a direct c/d wire or constant; one mux per such output suffices

numeric.types: Unsigned one-bit Boolean inputs and four-bit packed output
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, overflow, rounding, saturation, or signed operations
numeric.input_domain: K-map specifies binary 0/1 inputs; X/Z behavior is unspecified

verification.gate: Run supplied validate_contract.py before writing RTL; structural gate is not functional proof
verification.oracle: Independent literal K-map row values, arranged in ab binary selector order 00,01,10,11
verification.coverage: Exhaust all four c,d pairs and all four external a,b selector pairs; repeat in reverse order to check combinational changes
verification.comparison: Compare full mux_in vector and independently selected output against original K-map
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite compile and simulation timeouts
verification.preservation: Save candidate_initial.sv immediately after implementation before checks or edits; preserve revisions and logs
